[USER] User asked about the impact of the feminist movement on gender roles in the 20th century.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The feminist movement impacted gender roles in the 20th century by challenging traditional gender norms and promoting gender equality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Significant changes included greater opportunities for education and employment, the ability to own property, and the right to vote.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The movement also challenged gender stereotypes and encouraged men to rethink traditional notions of masculinity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It raised awareness of issues such as sexual harassment, reproductive rights, and domestic violence.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, the feminist movement destabilized gender roles and opened up new possibilities for individuals of all genders.  
[USER] User expressed interest in the topic by stating, "That's really interesting."  
[USER] User asked for key events or milestones of the feminist movement in the 20th century.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Key events and milestones included:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Women's Suffrage: The 19th Amendment was ratified in 1920, giving women in the U.S. the right to vote.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Second Wave Feminism: Focused on reproductive rights, workplace discrimination, and sexual harassment in the 1960s and 1970s.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Equal Pay Act: Passed in 1963, requiring equal pay for equal work regardless of sex.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Roe v. Wade: The 1973 Supreme Court ruling that women have a constitutional right to choose abortion.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Title IX: Passed in 1972, prohibiting sex discrimination in education programs receiving federal funding.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Women in the Workplace: Increased participation of women in the workforce in traditionally male-dominated fields.  
[USER] User remarked on the progress made in the century and inquired about ongoing issues the feminist movement advocates for today.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ongoing issues include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Gender Pay Gap: Women still earn less than men in most industries despite the Equal Pay Act.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Reproductive Rights: Ongoing efforts to restrict access to abortion and reproductive health services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Sexual Harassment: The Me Too movement highlighted the prevalence of sexual harassment and assault.
